name: IPF: capital flow management measures
summary: State-contingent tax on capital inflows: raised in inflow booms to curb foreign-currency debt build-up (prudential), relaxed in busts; leans on reserves and the premium.
checks: measure is countercyclical (tightened in booms, eased in busts)
distortion of efficient flows is reported
use is consistent with the stated policy framework for capital flows
